“毕竟我只是上来顶一下的，怎么可能赢得了神王呢？”看着镜中的自己，369自嘲一笑，“还是洗把脸回去练烟位吧。”369低下头，再抬起时却发现身后多了一人，黄黑的队标，魅惑的眼镜，竟是刚刚击败自己的神王宙活！
“你来干什么，嘲讽我吗。”369后退一步，努力绷起表情。
“我没这种心情，我来这是为了别的事情。”宙活轻扫一眼旁边的69，刚刚的胜利似乎没有在他心中产生什么喜悦。
“……你什么意思？”369带着戒备。
“你没必要这样，被人不做期望的感觉很难受吧，明明自己也是职业选手。”宙活边说边走近369，直到把他逼到墙角
“你就不想变强吗？”，恶魔的低语在69耳边响起，“接受我的神王基因，然后去送走其他lpl战队，我不想看到他们出现在我面前。”宙活的眼中燃起危险的光，双手强行把住369的头，让他直视自己。
“不要！我是lpl选手，我是不会让你如愿的！”369奋力挣扎，可已经泯了太久的他在宙活手中显得毫无反抗能力。
“这可由不得你了！接住我的神王基因，然后去扫清你的同赛区兄弟吧！”
…………
“69！怎么还没洗完啊，大家都在等你呢。”匆匆赶来寻找69的哥哥走进洗手间，却只看到呆呆站在镜子前的369。
“哦，好，我知道了，走吧。”369转过身，沉默着往前走。
“……9哥，你没事吧，一把比赛而已，大家都知道你尽力了。”哥哥担心的望向369，只觉得他的背影有些陌生。
“我没事，走吧，明天还要打al呢，还有……”369停下脚步，缓缓回头，
“以后叫我神王。”

top.en: S16 Swiss Stage, Round 1. After HLE beat TES, a dejected 369 walked off the stage and went to the restroom alone to clear his head. Cold water splashed on his face, but the feeling of losing was still so complicated. 'After all, I was just a stand-in, how could I possibly beat the God King?' 369 laughed at himself in the mirror, 'Better wash my face and go back to practicing [~0:smoke duty].' 369 lowered his head, but when he looked up, he found someone behind him. The yellow and black team logo, the charming glasses—it was the God King Zeus who had just defeated him! 'What are you here for? To mock me?' 369 stepped back, trying to keep his composure. 'I'm not in the mood for that. I'm here for something else.' Zeus glanced at 369; the recent victory didn't seem to bring him any joy. '...What do you mean?' 369 asked, guarded. 'You don't have to be like this. It feels terrible to be someone nobody expects anything from, even though you're a pro player too.' Zeus walked closer to 369 as he spoke, until he had him cornered. 'Don't you want to get stronger?' The devil's whisper echoed in 69's ear, 'Accept my God King genes, and go [~1:int] away the other LPL teams. I don't want to see them in front of me.' A dangerous light ignited in Zeus's eyes as he grabbed 369's head, forcing him to look him in the eye. 'No! I'm an LPL player, I won't let you get your way!' 369 struggled, but having been [~2:washed up] for too long, he looked powerless in Zeus's hands. 'That's not up to you! Take my God King genes, and go wipe out your brothers from the same region!' ... '69! Why aren't you done washing up? Everyone is waiting for you.' His brother, who had rushed to find 69, walked into the restroom, only to see 369 standing blankly in front of the mirror. 'Oh, right, I know, let's go.' 369 turned around and walked forward in silence. '...Brother 9, are you okay? It's just one game, everyone knows you tried your best.' His brother looked at 369 with concern, feeling his back looked somewhat unfamiliar. 'I'm fine, let's go. We have to play AL tomorrow, and also...' 369 stopped and slowly turned back, 'Call me God King from now on.'

notes.context: Refers to playing controller agents in Valorant, used here to mock 369 for allegedly playing Valorant instead of practicing LoL.
Slang for inting or feeding the enemy kills.
Used here to mean being washed up or having lost one's competitive edge.
